steps_to_reproduce: Open task-linked EN-FM-001, click the visible eCIgn Sign control, wait for E-SIGN consent workspace.
expected_result: Signing flow opens consent, identity, review, signature, attestation, lock/finalize steps.
actual_result: The visible Sign control did not advance to the consent workspace; Playwright timed out waiting for the E-SIGN consent checkbox.
console_error: locator.check timeout waiting for consent checkbox
recommended_fix: Verify the signature button target/role gating and ensure authorized DON/power-user signing opens eCIgn consent instead of remaining on the form.

steps_to_reproduce: Open task-linked form, persist its canonical instance, mark it completed through the app execution store, then open the artifact route.
expected_result: Completed form instance opens a reviewable immutable completed/signed artifact, not a blank template or no-preview state.
actual_result: Viewer reports signed artifact is not available in this session.
recommended_fix: Create a durable completed/signed snapshot whenever a form reaches terminal status and make Artifact Viewer retrieve it from the canonical artifact store.
